encounters.scenario: A customer buying a laptop accepts a discounted mouse-and-sleeve bundle offered by the salesperson.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good evening. What are you looking for today?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I called about the 14-inch laptop with 16 GB RAM. You quoted ₹42,990. Is it available?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, we have it in silver. Same configuration and the same price. Shall I bring a sealed piece?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, please. The charger is included, right?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, the original charger is inside the box. With this laptop, you can also take a wireless mouse and a padded sleeve together for ₹999. Separately, those two come to ₹1,498.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I wasn't planning on accessories. Can I see the sleeve first?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Of course. Here it is. This size fits the 14-inch model, and there's a small pocket in front.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: And the mouse works with a USB receiver?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes. The receiver is stored under the battery cover. One AA battery is included.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Okay, add both for ₹999. The sleeve will be useful for my office commute.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Done. Laptop plus the mouse-and-sleeve bundle comes to ₹43,989, including GST.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Fine. I'll pay by card. Please put my name on the invoice.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Certainly. Please give me your name, and we'll check the laptop together after billing.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: It's Rahul Mehta. Yes, I'd like to check it before leaving.

encounters.notes: The proactive discounted accessory bundle offer in turn 5 is the single upsell attempt. The customer accepts in turn 10. Subsequent product explanations and billing fulfill the customer's requests.

encounters.scenario: A customer shopping for a basic work laptop considers and accepts a premium model upgrade, followed by an extended warranty.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good evening. What are you looking for today?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I need a laptop for office work. Mostly Excel, emails and video calls. Around forty-five thousand.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: This one is ₹42,990, with 8 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD. It will handle that work. Please try the keyboard.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Keyboard feels fine. I usually have quite a few sheets open during calls, though. My current laptop hangs then.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: For that, I would suggest considering this premium model. It has 16 GB RAM, a newer processor and a brighter screen. It is above your budget, but the extra memory should help when you have everything open together.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: How much above? I don't want the budget to keep going up.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: It is ₹49,990, including GST. So ₹7,000 more than the first laptop, and ₹4,990 above the budget you mentioned.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Hmm, let me think. I use it every day, and I don't want the same hanging problem again. All right, I'll take the 16 GB model.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sure. One optional addition before I make the bill: two years of extended warranty is ₹3,499. That starts after the included one-year warranty and covers mechanical and electrical failures under the plan terms. Would you like to add it?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Another three and a half thousand... Does that cover a broken screen also, or only faults in the laptop?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Only covered faults. Accidental screen damage, liquid damage and normal battery wear are excluded. Here are the written terms; you can check them before deciding. With the warranty, your total would be ₹53,489.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Let me read that once. Okay, I understand the exclusions. I'm planning to keep this for at least four years, so yes, add the extended warranty.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Done. The 16 GB laptop and the two-year extension come to ₹53,489. I'll put the warranty details on the invoice as well. Card or UPI?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Card, please. And please email me the invoice and warranty document.

encounters.notes: The proactive premium-model recommendation and optional extended-warranty offer are the two upsell attempts. Subsequent price answers, coverage explanations and billing confirmations fulfill customer requests or complete accepted purchases.

encounters.scenario: Baarish par thodi casual baat ke baad customer ek wired mouse kharidta hai. Salesperson ek baar mousepad cross-sell karta hai.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Arre, bahar abhi bhi baarish ho rahi hai kya?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, halki ho gayi hai ab. Das minute toh saamne shed ke neeche khada tha.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Achha kiya. Yahan entrance pe bhi paani aa gaya tha, abhi saaf kiya hai.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, aaj toh achanak hi shuru ho gayi.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Bilkul. Bataiye, kya chahiye tha?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Ek simple wired mouse chahiye, laptop ke liye. Paanch sau ke andar.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yeh wala 449 ka hai. Normal USB port hai na aapke laptop mein?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, hai. Ek baar chala ke dikha do bas.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji, is demo laptop pe laga deta hoon. Yeh dekhiye, click aur scroll dono check kar lijiye.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, theek chal raha hai. Yehi pack kar do.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Iske saath mousepad bhi chahiye? Basic wala 99 ka hai.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Nahi, mousepad ghar pe hai. Sirf mouse de do. UPI kar doon?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Haan ji, yeh QR hai. Total 449. Mouse aur bill is bag mein rakh diye hain.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Ho gaya payment, dekho. Theek hai, thank you.

encounters.notes: Opening small talk contains no selling. Showing and testing the requested wired mouse is request fulfillment. The only upsell attempt is the unsolicited mousepad offer in turn 11; the salesperson accepts the refusal without another push.
